name: value-utilities/arbitrary-color-with-alpha
description: Arbitrary color values that already carry their own alpha bypass the `--tw-*-opacity` wrapping path — `bg-[#0b14374d]` (8-char hex), `bg-[#abcd]` (4-char hex), `text-[rgba(255,255,255,0.15)]` (legacy 4-arg rgba), `bg-[hsla(0,_50%,_50%,_0.5)]` (legacy 4-arg hsla). The oracle emits the value verbatim. Without the embedded-alpha detection, Galeforce wrapped them with `var(--tw-*-opacity, 1)` and produced syntactically-broken declarations.
